Container.Name: misterdownloadmanager
Container.Overview: Mister Download Manager without a window: add links, magnets and torrents from your phone or browser, and the server downloads them into a share. Pair a phone with the code in the container's log.

Config.Name: Remote control
Config.Description: The page phones and browsers use (HTTPS).

Config.Name: Settings
Config.Description: The list, settings, certificate and paired devices.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Where downloads land (a folder per category inside).

Config.Name: Page address
Config.Description: The address you open the page with, such as https://192.168.1.10:8463/ (shown with the pairing code).

Config.Name: Server names
Config.Description: Names besides the address the page may be opened by, separated by commas.
